notes.title: Support for macOS Now Available
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Thanks for all the wonderful words about Short Trip so far. It's been so heartwarming to see!

This patch adds support for macOS running Sillicon or Intel processors. Thanks for your patience while I got this build verified!

Let me know if you encounter any issues at all, and I'll get right on it.

Thank you,

Alex

notes.title: Hand-drawn cat railway game Short Trip is coming to Steam
notes.content: "A scenic tram ride, for cats." That's the powerful sell for Short Trip delivered in its trailer, after which anything I say would be redundant. But I'm going to say it anyway... Read more.
